title: ONLY a cup holder
text: ONLY a cup holder. This adhered very well and is an excellent cup holder, but my toothbrush kept falling out.  Needless to say, I was not happy with this problem!  A toothbrush on the floor is not a happy sight!  I do use it as a cup holder though.
